name: gitignore-check
description: Is this path ignored by git, and by which .gitignore line? Same answer as git check-ignore, without a repository.
long_description: check_ignored tells, for each path, whether git ignores it and which file and line decides, with git's exact rules: negation, anchoring, dir/ rules, **, character classes, nested .gitignore files, and the rule that nothing inside an ignored directory can be re-included. explain_gitignore explains each line in plain English and flags the classic mistakes. Port of git's own matching code, checked against git check-ignore on about 80,000 random cases. Offline, read-only. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).

tools.name: check_ignored
tools.description: Is each path ignored by git, and which .gitignore line decides.

tools.description: Each .gitignore line in plain English, with the classic mistakes flagged.
